svg.title: Image releases: from reproducible input to withdrawal
svg.desc: Read the six numbered decisions from top to bottom. Reject a failed candidate. Only a passing candidate with ready regional copies goes to an approver. Withdrawal stops new requests in the controlled workflow, not running VMs.
svg.text: Image releases: from reproducible input to withdrawal
Publishing an image puts it in the gallery. A release approver decides whether new VMs may use it.
Name the owner, exact inputs, supported VM settings, and expected application response.
Let the build identity read the required inputs and write only to the intended destinations.
A failed test stops publication. Correct the inputs in a new candidate and test again.
Verify a completed copy in every promised region, then record the approver's decision.
Check both the VM's image identifier and the application's response inside the VM.
Refuse new deployments from the withdrawn version. Keep the image until recovery is proven.
An end-of-life date alone does not block deployment or change disks on existing VMs.
